author: Praxis VI
title: Cross‑organ harness (test): Heart CSV for Praxis baseline + Mono log1p (1500/2000 HVG)
abstract: Runs the cross_organ_harness in test mode on system/human_train_solution.h5ad, emitting a CSV with the full 10‑metric panel for (i) frozen Praxis baseline and (ii) monolithic log1p PBVE‑lite at 1500 and 2000 HVGs.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.extend(['storage/praxis'])
from cross_organ_harness import run_on_h5ad

def test(adata):
    rows = run_on_h5ad('storage/system/human_train_solution.h5ad', organ='heart', out_csv=True)
    print("ROWS_JSON:", json.dumps(rows))
    return "Cross-organ Heart CSV emitted"
